text: {"lessons":["After buying in Period 5, I held through several ups and downs; I should review whether each holding still fits my plan instead of trading just because of a monthly move.","My five-stock purchase was only part of the account, so I should track how both my cash and stock exposure contribute to progress toward the apartment goal.","A short record with modest gains and losses cannot show whether my approach works; I should keep investing regularly and judge progress over years, while managing risk."]}
